zakat.claim_evidence: Good Measure Giving, a charity evaluation platform, suggests that IIIT should 'Add a dedicated zakat page or clearly state whether donations are zakat-eligible.' This indicates that IIIT does not currently explicitly accept zakat donations or have a dedicated zakat fund. Furthermore, IIIT is described as a 'scholarly hub' focused on 'intellectual advancement of Islamic thought' and 'academic research and leadership training,' rather than a humanitarian charity serving the general public. (Source: https://goodmeasuregiving.org/charity/23-2202414/)
